Source: https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1487

Reported safety failure: an agent ran config set before init in a separate nested repository and changed the enclosing tracker; append-only outer history retained that mistake after restoration. Do not test against the real tracker or repair historical entries destructively. Investigate the SDK discovery primitive and all mutation/read adapters, then document compatibility for users intentionally sharing a parent tracker.
GH-1487: Respect nested Git repository boundaries during tracker discovery

Investigate implicit tracker discovery crossing the nearest Git repository boundary and silently mutating an enclosing repository tracker when the nested repository has no tracker. Preserve explicit tracker overrides and intentional workspace policies.

Reproduce in disposable outer/inner Git repositories and verify outer bytes/history remain unchanged on refused inner mutations; cover .git directories and files, worktrees, submodules and ordinary subdirectories; preserve explicit --pm-path and PM_PATH plus documented deliberate cross-root policy; expose actionable boundary and initialization recovery through SDK, CLI and MCP.
